mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies with a temperature of 53 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park and a first quarter moon appearing tonight. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Public Works Department is hard at work maintaining our city streets and utilities. They encourage all residents to visit the city website to subscribe to the newsletter for important updates on infrastructure and waste management programs.

There is plenty to do in Verona starting today with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music tomorrow at Paddy Mac's or join the paving project information meeting on December 8.
In a report of notable calls for service, on November 4, a woman was arrested for O W I following a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Turtle. We are currently open until 10 PM, so come on by for a treat while you still can.
